identityModel.releaseObject: An individual proof artifact has its own exact PDF SHA-256 and artifact digest; TYP-09D records the exact B5 artifact physically reviewed.
identityModel.rebuildEquivalence: Fresh Vivliostyle renders are accepted as the same production typography object only when page geometry/counts, finished fonts, semantic regressions and reader-content layout/raster fingerprints match this frozen production-CI contract. The live provenance page is verified structurally but excluded from cross-run fingerprints because its revision string intentionally follows the checked-out commit.
identityModel.rawPdfByteReproducibility: not claimed across independent Vivliostyle renders

crossRunProof.finding: Raw PDF SHA-256 values vary across independent Vivliostyle runners, and the live provenance page intentionally varies with the checked-out revision. Production rebuild equivalence is therefore defined by frozen reader-page Poppler text-layout, bounding-box-layout and complete-page raster fingerprints plus permanent semantic/font/geometry checks. TYP-09C closes only when two independent CI replicas pass the same frozen reader-content fingerprints.

pltCompatibility.interpretation: The current token remains the protected drawing-publication-v1 working value. PLT has not yet frozen drawing-publication-v2. TYP-09C therefore certifies the TYP-06 interface and absence of a competing PLT family, not a nonexistent v2 implementation.
pltCompatibility.requiredJoinCondition: Before drawing-publication-v2 release, PLT must make its central drawing-token seam consume the frozen Source Sans 3 identity and re-prove BOOK/WALL outputs without a local family fork.

coldPdfReview.reviewMode: screen/PDF cold review; not a substitute for final physical proof
coldPdfReview.finding: No new typography design question was exposed. Title/imprint separation, division thresholds, ordinary chapter/prose hierarchy, Part IV transition, architectural plate typography, Part V threshold and dense source material remain coherent in the production object.

manufacturing.spineWidthClaim: not admissible without final paper caliper / manufacturing specification
